Annual Leap Sandcastle Classic

Sat at 11am · San Francisco
Ocean Beach turns into a giant sand art gallery for the 44th Annual Leap Sandcastle Classic, hosted by LEAP Arts in Education Teams compete building massive, elaborate sand sculptures right at Balboa Street, it's free to watch and wander. Bring a jacket since the beach gets windy, wear shoes you don't mind getting sandy, and go midday when the sculptures are at their best This event is not hosted by Partiful. It is an event we recommend, hosted by LEAP Arts in Education. Find more details at the link above

Patchwork Show Oakland

Sat, Dec 12 at 11am · Oakland
The original alternative creative market in Southern California *and beyond. Est. 2007 Since 2007, Patchwork Show has been where creativity, community, and small business come together. What began as Orange County’s first alternative craft fair—a scrappy market in a Santa Ana parking lot—has grown into a multi-city festival celebrating local makers, food, music, and hands-on crafting. Patchwork Show isn’t just a market—it’s an incubator for creative businesses and a space where connections are made and creativity thrives. Vendors grow their brands and followings, while attendees discover unique handmade goods and the people behind them. Whether you’re here to shop, snack, or get inspired, Patchwork Show welcomes you with open arms. Because it’s not just about the goods—it’s about the community that brings them to life. Free to attend, Family and pet friendly, Free DIY crafts at select booths.

Dilwale Diwali

Fri at 6:30pm · San Jose
This Diwali, we're celebrating the big-hearted way — with music, food, and art from our own Bay Area South Asian community!! Come out to enjoy and support the roots of south asian culture and music that pervades the peninsula! Dilwale Diwali brings together up-and-coming South Asian indie artists for a night of live music, alongside local vendors slinging desi comfort food (mango lassi included, obviously) and South Asian makers showing off their art. Come dressed to shine, bring your people, and let's light this one up together. ✨ What to expect: 🎶 Live sets from Bay Area South Asian indie artists 🥭 Desi snacks (including mango lassi on deck!) 🎨 South Asian art + makers 🪔 Warm community! $12 advance $15 day of show 6:30 PM Doors 7:00 PM Music

Bean-Up

Sun at 1pm · Berkeley
Do you love beans? Join your fellow Bay Area Bean Lovers to celebrate the best holiday and the best food. What is a bean-up? A place to let your love of beans run wild, build community, and eat some really incredible food. Mahjong in the Mission

Next Wed at 6pm · San Francisco
Join Mo Pai Mahjong Club for mahjong night! We'll be transforming Society of Thumbs—part art studio, part neighborhood hub—into an open play area. Having grown up in the Mission and Excelsior, I thought it would be fun to pop up in a new neighborhood. Come go offline with me and shuffle some tiles in this creative new third space. Details: 🀄️ Admission includes a dedicated playing seat for 3 hours plus light snacks. You are also welcome to bring outside food. 🀄️ Please indicate your playing level in the questionnaire to help with assigned seating. We will have competitive tables playing for points, but are also opening it up to beginners. (Visual handouts will be provided.) 🀄️ If you would like to be seated together, please indicate that in a comment once you RSVP. 🀄️ All ticket sales are final. We are unable to issue refunds. 🀄️ Tickets are not sold at the door. Clicking "Going" in the RSVP does not guarantee admission. You must purchase a ticket via Venmo. 🀄️ After making your Venmo payment, make sure you hit “Going" in Partiful so your ticket is accounted for and we don’t oversell.

THRIFT or TREAT: Community Garage Sale / Swap + Open Decks

Sat at 11am · San Francisco
Spooked by your growing donation pile? Don't let those closet skeletons haunt you another season. Bring them to Thrift or Treat, a community "garage sale" where everything must ghost. Don't have anything to add to the bootique? Kindly leave the space better than you found it.

Junksgiving

Sat, Nov 14 at 1pm · Escalon
🩷🦃✨ JUNKSGIVING ✨🦃🩷 A Friendsgiving for Junk Journal Lovers Three local junk journal clubs. One very special library. One epic afternoon of crafting, connecting, snacking, and celebrating our little creative community. 💕📖✂️ Crafty Crew + Stockton Junk Journal Club + Confetti & Chaos Junk Journal Club are coming together for Junksgiving at the Escalon Branch Library, and we want YOU there! Whether you’re a longtime friend, brand-new to the junk journaling world, or somewhere in between, come spend the afternoon with us as we celebrate Friendsgiving—the junk journal way. 🥧📓✨ Our amazing hosts at the Escalon Branch Library are graciously opening their doors to us FREE OF CHARGE and providing SO much for us to enjoy! 🎉 WHAT’S INCLUDED: ✨ Free crafting supplies 🥤 A FREE Dirty Soda Bar 🍿 FREE snacks 🎟️ FREE raffle prizes 📚 Plenty of space to journal, create & hang out 💗 A little bit of each club’s personality, creativity & chaos And the best part? You don’t need to bring a thing! Just bring your journal, your favorite personal supplies if you have them, and yourself. The library is taking care of the rest! 👯‍♀️ WHO IS THIS FOR? Everyone! Old friends, new friends, seasoned journalers, curious beginners—we want you there. The vibe is casual, welcoming, and come-as-you-are. There will be plenty of time to craft, chat, share ideas, make new friends, and maybe leave with a little more inspiration than you came with. 💕 Children are welcome with an adult. We just ask that kiddos be mindful of the adults who are journaling and creating. The library also has a fun kids’ corner, so if babysitting is what’s keeping you home, bring them along! This isn’t just another craft meetup. It’s a Junksgiving. Three clubs. One community. A whole lot of paper, creativity, snacks & chaos. 🦃💗✂️ Come celebrate with us—we can’t wait to journal with you! 📍 Escalon Branch Library 1540 2nd St., Escalon 🗓️ Saturday, November 14 ⏰ 1:00–4:00 PM

Halloween Fiesta

Thu, Oct 29 at 4:30pm · Stockton
🎃 Glue Sticks & Guac: A Halloween Crafty Crew Fiesta 👻 Come join us for a spooky, crafty night of junk journaling, analog hobbies, good food, and good company! 🖤✨ We’re bringing the Crafty Crew together for a Halloween fiesta where all analog hobbies are welcome—junk journals, scrapbooking, collaging, paper crafts, happy mail, and whatever crafty obsession you’re currently into. Bring your current project, come make something new, or just come hang out and soak up the crafty chaos! Your $12 ticket includes: 🍕 At least 2 slices of pizza 🥑 Chips & guacamole 🎟️ Lots of fun raffle opportunities 🎃 A Halloween Bingo game with prizes and surprises ✂️ A scrap pack to get those creative juices flowing 🪎 Costume contest 👻 An evening with your crafty people! 🍕 And let’s talk pizza… We’re heading to El 2 Carnales, and I am SO excited for you guys to try their specialty pizzas! They have some amazing Mexican-style pizzas loaded with toppings, but since some of those toppings can be a little adventurous (hello, cilantro 😂), I’m putting together a selection that everyone can enjoy—including specialty pizzas + pepperoni. And yes… there will absolutely be guac. Because obviously we couldn’t call it Glue Sticks & Guac without the guac! 😂🥑 Drinks are not included with the ticket. I wanted to leave drinks open so you can order whatever you actually want instead of being limited to a fountain soda. And if you haven’t tried their horchata yet… my daughter swears it’s the best around, so consider that your personal recommendation. 😉 👻 Costumes & Crafty Chaos Costumes are totally encouraged, and we’ll be having a Halloween Costume Contest, so feel free to get creative! Whether you’re coming dressed as a spooky little goblin, your favorite fictional character, a crafty witch, or just yourself with a glue stick in hand—we want you there. It’s a Thursday night, I know! 🥹 But I’m really hoping you can make it. Come craft, eat, laugh, play bingo, win some raffles, and spend a few hours with your fellow crafty weirdos. 🖤🎃 Bring your project. Bring your scissors. Bring your glue. Bring your creativity. We’ll bring the guac. 🥑✨

This isn’t just another craft meetup. It’s a Junksgiving. Three clubs. One community. Patchwork Show Oakland

Sat, Dec 12 at 11am · Oakland
The original alternative creative market in Southern California *and beyond. Est. 2007 Since 2007, Patchwork Show has been where creativity, community, and small business come together. What began as Orange County’s first alternative craft fair—a scrappy market in a Santa Ana parking lot—has grown into a multi-city festival celebrating local makers, food, music, and hands-on crafting. Patchwork Show isn’t just a market—it’s an incubator for creative businesses and a space where connections are made and creativity thrives. Vendors grow their brands and followings, while attendees discover unique handmade goods and the people behind them. Whether you’re here to shop, snack, or get inspired, Patchwork Show welcomes you with open arms. Because it’s not just about the goods—it’s about the community that brings them to life. Free to attend, Family and pet friendly, Free DIY crafts at select booths.
